messages.subject: secr 4.2.2
parts:
The next release of secr fixes these critical bugs:
    o   individual covariate (CL) models for proximity data failed unless fastproximity = FALSE
    o   join() sometimes failed (circumstances unclear)
The fixes are available in secr 4.2.1 at https://www.otago.ac.nz/density/SECRinR.html. This will eventually appear on CRAN as secr 4.2.2 (with a trivial tweak to fix a CRAN problem with Examples in suggest.buffer.Rd).
